as_at.description: The day the balances are at, inclusive.

rows.description: Each director and shareholder with something to disclose, in the order they were added: a schedule, whole, not a page of a list.

year_from.description: The first day of the year the fees, conversions and waivers are read from: the financial year as_at falls in, or the calendar year when the financial years are not set.
